content.value_statement: Email systems fail when deliverability, consent, and tracking are treated as afterthoughts. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through reliable email architecture and compliant delivery practices.
actual_capabilities: Designs transactional email queues with retry and monitoring patterns.
Explains delivery event tracking for opens, clicks, bounces, and complaints.
Defines SPF, DKIM, DMARC, List-Unsubscribe, and bounce handling practices.
Provides React Email template patterns with plain text and preview text.
Documents IP warm-up, preference centers, and rate limit considerations.
Outlines validation checks for common email implementation issues.
limitations: Does not connect to an email provider or send email directly.
Requires provider documentation to configure DNS, webhooks, and API limits.
Does not replace legal review for CAN-SPAM, GDPR, or regional compliance.
Examples need adaptation and testing before production use.

use_cases.title: Ship Transactional Email
use_cases.description: Design queues, retries, bounce handling, and monitoring for password resets, receipts, and account alerts.

use_cases.title: Improve Deliverability
use_cases.description: Plan SPF, DKIM, DMARC, unsubscribe headers, and IP warm-up before campaigns scale.

use_cases.title: Review Email Templates
use_cases.description: Check templates for plain text, preview text, accessible images, and clear calls to action.

prompt_templates.title: Start an Email Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to outline an email system for [product]. Cover transactional messages, marketing messages, consent, and provider choices.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Template
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review this email template for deliverability, accessibility, unsubscribe handling, and preview text: [paste template].

prompt_templates.title: Design Bounce Handling
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design bounce and complaint handling for [provider]. Include webhook events, database state, retries, and alert thresholds.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Production Launch
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to audit our launch plan for [campaign or product]. Check DNS records, IP warm-up, rate limits, logging, and compliance risks.

output_examples.input: Review a welcome email before launch.
output_examples.output: The review identifies missing plain text, absent preview text, and weak unsubscribe handling. It recommends fixes before the campaign is scheduled.

output_examples.input: Plan transactional email for account recovery.
output_examples.output: The plan recommends a queue, provider retry handling, bounce webhooks, separate transactional sender identity, and delivery monitoring.
The assessment starts with engaged recipients, gradual volume increases, and monitoring for bounce, complaint, delivery, and open trends.

best_practices: Separate transactional and marketing email streams to protect critical delivery.
Configure SPF, DKIM, DMARC, bounce handling, and unsubscribe headers before scaling volume.
Log each send attempt and monitor bounce, complaint, delivery, open, and click events.
anti_patterns: Sending purchased or scraped contacts without explicit consent.
Sending high volume from a new IP before warm-up.
Shipping HTML-only or image-only emails without accessible text.

faq.question: Can this skill send emails?
faq.answer: No. It provides architecture, review guidance, and implementation patterns. You still need an email provider and tested application code.

faq.question: Which providers does it cover?
faq.answer: It mentions providers such as Postmark, Resend, SendGrid, ConvertKit, and Customer.io as examples. It does not replace provider docs.

faq.question: Does it handle compliance?
faq.answer: It highlights consent, unsubscribe, CAN-SPAM, and GDPR concerns. Legal requirements vary, so use qualified legal review for policy decisions.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it during implementation?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance can help Claude Code and Codex review templates, queues, webhooks, and launch plans.

faq.question: Is it only for marketing email?
faq.answer: No. It covers transactional email, marketing automation, deliverability, templates, event tracking, and validation checks.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide product context, email types, provider details, sending volume, templates, and compliance constraints.
